verdict.rationale: Batch mode handles high-volume transcription, accepting up to 10,000 audio files per job or 1,000 from a manifest, including all files under an S3 prefix with glob filters. That gives developers a first-party way to process many files at once. The evidence never documents concurrency limits, parallel job execution, or queueing behavior, which are the core of this story. missing for 10: documented per-account concurrency limits, documented queueing and backpressure behavior when limits are exceeded, explicit support for running multiple jobs in parallel, rate-limit/429 handling guidance, independent corroboration.
